hassio_confirm.title: HA Claude Code Assist
hassio_confirm.description: Use the {app} app as a conversation agent for Assist? You choose it afterwards in Settings > Voice assistants.

error.cannot_connect: The app does not answer. Check that it is running, then try again.
error.invalid_token: The app refused its token. Restart the app, then add it again from Discovered.

abort.already_configured: HA Claude Code Assist is already set up.
abort.discovery_only: Home Assistant finds HA Claude Code Assist by itself while the app is running. Start the app, then add it from Discovered in Settings > Devices & services.

app_outdated.title: The HA Claude Code Assist app is out of date
app_outdated.description: The HA Claude Code Assist app is older than its integration, so Assist cannot use it. Update the app in Settings > Apps. This message goes away by itself once the app is updated.
